The harbour authority published its annual review of vessel traffic on Tuesday. Container arrivals rose by eight percent compared with the previous year, while passenger sailings declined slightly because of two cancelled routes. Engineers inspected the northern quay in March and recommended replacing eleven of the older fenders before the winter storms begin. Funding for the work will come from a fee on cargo above 4,000 tonnes. The council will vote on the proposal in September, and residents may send written comments until the first of that month.
